name: Translation and Proofreading
description: English text is checked for spelling and grammar, German text is translated into English, on this computer only. In the inspector (its own tab) or in a window of its own: the text goes in, the result comes out with every change marked; a click on a word keeps the original or offers other words, and the rest of the sentence is fitted to the word chosen. Rules: no em-dashes, American spelling, curly quotes, three periods instead of the ellipsis character, and your own replacements. The models are chosen and downloaded once under File > Options > Translation and Proofreading (CoEdIT Large: best, non-commercial use only; CoEdIT Base: free; OPUS-MT German to English), checked, and then used without any connection. Engine: CTranslate2 with oneDNN and SentencePiece. Brings Qt's TLS plugin for the download.
author: The Quillbinder Translation Add-on project
whatsNew: First version: proofreading (English) and translation (German to English) in the inspector and in a window
Click a marked word to keep the original or to choose another word; other words for every word
The models are your choice (File > Options); rules for em-dashes, American spelling, quotes, your own replacements
